scoring_justification: Full recompute of J-integrals from raw FE simulation output is infeasible in the verifier sandbox (requires simulation environment). Instead, we check consistency of reported values with paper's reference values within tolerance, structural trends (Cp sign region, monotonicity), and file format.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference J-integral values derived from paper Fig. 3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figure 3 and reference solve.sh output (representing correct re-run of the C(T) specimen simulation)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from paper Fig. 3 and verified against the workflow's reference solution solve.sh output. The values are the correct result of applying the described configurational force post-processing to a correct FE simulation of the C(T) specimen as specified.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the expected output of a faithful reproduction of the paper's computational study. They are traceable to the paper's reported J-far and near-tip J-integrals, and match the reference solution oracle produce.

outputs.description: CSV of computed far‑field J‑integral, near‑tip J‑integral (within 2‑mm contour), and plasticity influence term Cp for the C(T) specimen at the specified load‑line displacements.
